# TDrive v3.1.9

This release changes how Android folder import handles a file that already
exists on the drive under the same name. Instead of skipping or renaming it
silently, TDrive asks what to do. It also creates the folder you picked even
when that folder is empty. Bản phát hành này thay đổi cách nhập thư mục trên
Android khi một tệp đã có trên drive với cùng tên. Thay vì bỏ qua hoặc đổi tên
âm thầm, TDrive sẽ hỏi bạn muốn làm gì. Thư mục bạn chọn cũng được tạo ngay cả
khi thư mục đó trống.

## Highlights

- Same name, different size: before anything is sent, TDrive asks whether to
  Replace the file on the drive, Keep both, or Skip. Skip is the default, and
  canceling the question sends nothing. With several clashes, one choice can be
  applied to all of them.
- Replace moves the old file to Trash, where you can restore it. The new copy
  is confirmed on the drive before the old one is moved, and then it takes the
  original name.
- Keep both saves the new file as the first free name, such as `photo_1.jpg`.
  The name also avoids folders that the same import is about to create.
- An empty folder you pick is created on the drive, even when nothing goes into it.
- The Transfers entry notes how many files were replaced, kept or skipped.

## Known limits

- Replace uses Trash, so the old file can be restored, but it is not a
  Telegram revision.
- A file whose size is unknown, or whose drive check fails, is uploaded as a
  copy without asking.
- Retrying a failed import does not carry your clash answers, so the question
  can appear again.
- A file name that contains a backslash makes its whole upload batch fail.
- The Transfers row title can cut off the replaced and kept counts. The full
  text is in the history and notification.
- The Android build was tested on an x86_64 emulator with automated tests. The
  ARM64 release APK was not run on a phone.

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows 10/11 (64-bit) | `TDrive-v3.1.9-windows-amd64-setup.exe` | Installer. A portable `TDrive-v3.1.9-windows-amd64.zip` is also attached. |
| macOS (Apple silicon) | `TDrive-v3.1.9-macos-arm64.zip` | Unzip and drag TDrive to Applications. |
| Linux (64-bit) | `TDrive-v3.1.9-x86_64.AppImage` | `chmod +x` it, then run it. Needs glibc 2.35 or newer. |
| Android 7.0 or newer (ARM64) | `TDrive-v3.1.9-android-arm64.apk` | Allow installs from your browser or file manager when Android asks. |
| iPhone / iPad (iOS 16 or newer) | `TDrive-v3.1.9-ios-unsigned.ipa` | Not signed. Install with TrollStore, Sideloadly or AltStore. |
